subject.title: [Feature Request] Session List: Show timestamp + last message preview

question: Should this narrow Sessions list preview land independently through the open linked PR, a replacement PR, or be folded into the broader sessions workspace design?
rationale: The UI gap is source-proven and the backend contract exists, but the linked external PR is conflicting/proof-needed and the issue already carries maintainer/product-decision labels, so starting a parallel automated fix would duplicate an unresolved product path.

options.title: Repair the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue paired with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/48396 and ask for a conflict-free branch that uses lastMessagePreview plus real Control UI proof.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow replacement
options.body: Close or supersede the stale branch only after a maintainer-backed replacement implements the same small UI change with tests and proof.

options.title: Fold into sessions workspace
options.body: Defer the narrow preview display into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if maintainers want one larger sessions-overview design instead of an incremental row preview.

recommendation.title: Repair the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue paired with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/48396 and ask for a conflict-free branch that uses lastMessagePreview plus real Control UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Control UI Sessions files and session row projection paths are most recently carried by steipete's commit history.
